wy_hardware_wall.blurb: Hardware Wall is a bolted face in Sinks Canyon, up the hillside from Lander. Look for it two rock panels left of Addiction Wall, with a large detached pillar on each side, and you reach it on a moderate uphill hike through open ground and some pines. Nearly all of the 32 climbs are single-pitch sport routes, and the bulk sit in the 5.11 and 5.12 range, with a few 5.10s, a lone 5.9 and several 5.13s, so it suits people already leading steady grades. The dolomite is clean with good friction. Sun hits the wall from morning into the afternoon before shade creeps in. Bring a full set of quickdraws, watch for loose rock around the pillars, and take rappel gear since not every route has a walk-off.

wy_hot_cinnamon_wall.blurb: Hot Cinnamon Wall is the western end of the Red Wall at Guernsey State Park, along the North Platte River in eastern Wyoming. Almost all of the 30 routes are bolted sport lines, with one trad route and one top rope. Grades cluster in the 5.10 and 5.11 range, with a couple of 5.12s, one 5.13 and a few easier lines, so it suits intermediate climbers. The wall catches the first sun of the whole Red Wall and is rarely troubled by wind, which makes it a favourite on cold days. The rock changes along the wall, with steep crimpy faces on the western side and more stemming and open-hand holds toward the east. Expect shade-free summer heat.
